verse.verse_2: By those who drive the clouds in a good way.
verse.verse_3: By those who bring the Dhikr.
verse.verse_4: Verily, your God is indeed One;
verse.verse_5: Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and all that is between them, and Lord of every point of the sun's risings.
verse.verse_6: Verily, We have adorned the near heaven with the stars.
verse.verse_7: And to guard against every rebellious Shaytan.
verse.verse_8: They cannot listen to the higher group for they are pelted from every side.
verse.verse_9: Outcast, and theirs is a constant torment.
verse.verse_10: Except such as snatch away something by stealing, and they are pursued by a flaming fire of piercing brightness.
verse.verse_11: Then ask them: "Are they harder to create, or those whom We have created" Verily, We created them of a sticky clay.
verse.verse_12: Nay, you wondered while they mock.
verse.verse_13: And when they are reminded, they pay no attention.
verse.verse_14: And when they see an Ayah (a sign) from Allah, they mock at it.
verse.verse_15: And they say: "This is nothing but evident magic!"
verse.verse_16: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we verily be resurrected"
verse.verse_18: Say: "Yes, and you shall then be humiliated."
verse.verse_19: It will be a single Zajrah, and behold, they will be staring!
verse.verse_20: They will say: "Woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense!"
verse.verse_21: (It will be said:) "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
verse.verse_22: (It will be said to the angels:) Assemble those who did wrong, together with their companions and what they used to worship,
verse.verse_23: Instead of Allah, and lead them on to the way of flaming Fire (Hell);
verse.verse_24: But stop them, verily, they are to be questioned.
verse.verse_25: "What is the matter with you Why do you not help one another"
verse.verse_26: Nay, but that Day they shall surrender.
verse.verse_27: And they will turn to one another and question one another.
verse.verse_28: They will say: "It was you who used to come to us from the right side."
verse.verse_29: They will reply: "Nay, you yourselves were not believers."
verse.verse_30: "And we had no authority over you. Nay! But you were a transgressing people."
verse.verse_31: "So now the Word of our Lord has been justified against us, that we shall certainly taste (the torment)."
verse.verse_32: "So we led you astray because we were ourselves astray."
verse.verse_33: Then verily, that Day, they will (all) share in the torment.
verse.verse_34: Certainly, that is how We deal with the criminals.
verse.verse_35: Truly, when it was said to them: "La ilaha illallah," they puffed themselves up with pride.
verse.verse_36: And (they) said: "Are we going to abandon our gods for the sake of a mad poet"
verse.verse_37: Nay! he has come with the truth and he confirms the Messengers.
verse.verse_38: Verily, you are going to taste the painful torment;
verse.verse_39: And you will be requited nothing except for what you used to do.
verse.verse_40: Save the chosen servants of Allah.
verse.verse_41: For them there will be a known provision,
verse.verse_42: Fruits; and they shall be honored,
verse.verse_45: Round them will be passed a cup of pure wine
verse.verse_47: Neither will they have Ghawl from that nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.
verse.verse_48: And beside them will be Qasirat-At-Tarf with (wide and beautiful) eyes.
verse.verse_49: as if they were Bayd Maknun.
verse.verse_50: Then they will turn to one another, mutually questioning.
verse.verse_51: A speaker of them will say: "Verily, I had a companion (in the world),"
verse.verse_52: "Who used to say: `Are you among those who believe.
verse.verse_53: (That) when we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed be indebted (Madinun)"'
verse.verse_55: So he looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.
verse.verse_56: He said: "By Allah! You have nearly ruined me."
verse.verse_57: "Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I would certainly have been among those brought forth (to Hell)."
verse.verse_58: "Are we then not to die (any more)"
verse.verse_59: "Except our first death, and we shall not be punished"
verse.verse_60: Truly, this is the supreme success!
verse.verse_61: For the like of this let the workers work.
verse.verse_62: Is that (Paradise) better entertainment or the tree of Zaqqum
verse.verse_63: Truly, We have made it (as) a trial for the wrongdoers.
verse.verse_64: Verily, it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-fire,
verse.verse_65: The shoots of its fruit stalks are like the heads of Shayatin.
verse.verse_66: Truly, they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.
verse.verse_67: Then on the top of that they will be given boiling Hamim.
verse.verse_68: Then thereafter, verily, their return is to the flaming fire of Hell.
verse.verse_69: Verily, they found their fathers on the wrong path;
verse.verse_70: So they (too) hastened in their footsteps!
verse.verse_71: And indeed most of the earlier ones went astray before them;
verse.verse_72: And indeed We sent among them warners;
verse.verse_73: Then see what was the end of those who were warned.
verse.verse_74: Except the chosen servants of Allah.
verse.verse_75: And indeed Nuh invoked Us, and We are the best of those who answer.
verse.verse_76: And We rescued him and his family from the great distress,
verse.verse_77: And, his progeny, them We made the survivors.
verse.verse_78: And left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations
verse.verse_79: "Salam (peace!) be upon Nuh among the all creatures!"
verse.verse_80: Verily, thus We reward the gooddoers.
verse.verse_81: Verily, he [Nuh] was one of Our believing servants.
verse.verse_83: And verily, among those who followed his way was Ibrahim.
verse.verse_84: When he came to his Lord with a Salim heart.
verse.verse_85: When he said to his father and to his people: "What is it that which you worship"
verse.verse_86: "Is it a falsehood -- gods other than Allah -- that you desire"
verse.verse_87: "Then what think you about the Lord of the all that exists"
verse.verse_88: Then he cast a glance at the stars,
verse.verse_89: And he said: "Verily, I am sick."
verse.verse_90: So they turned away from him and departed.
verse.verse_91: Then he turned to their gods and said: "Will you not eat"
verse.verse_92: "What is the matter with you that you speak not"
verse.verse_93: Then he turned upon them, striking (them) with (his) right hand.
verse.verse_94: Then they came hastily towards him.
verse.verse_95: He said: "Worship you that which you (yourselves) carve"
verse.verse_96: "While Allah has created you and what you make!"
verse.verse_97: They said: "Build for him a building and throw him into the blazing fire!"
verse.verse_98: So, they plotted a plot against him, but We made them the lowest.
verse.verse_99: And he said: "Verily, I am going to my Lord. He will guide me!"
verse.verse_100: "My Lord! Grant me (offspring) from the righteous."
verse.verse_101: So, We gave him the glad tidings of a forbearing boy.
verse.verse_102: And, when he (his son) was old enough to walk with him, he said: "O my son! I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering you. So look what you think!" He said: "O my father! Do that which you are commanded, if Allah wills, you shall find me of the patient."
verse.verse_103: Then, when they had both submitted themselves, and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead;
verse.verse_104: We called out to him: "O Ibrahim!"
verse.verse_105: "You have fulfilled the dream!" Verily, thus do We reward the doers of good.
verse.verse_106: Verily, that indeed was a manifest trial.
verse.verse_107: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice;
verse.verse_108: And We left for him among the later generations.
verse.verse_110: Thus indeed do We reward the doers of good.
verse.verse_111: Verily, he was one of Our believing servants.
verse.verse_112: And We gave him the glad tidings of Ishaq -- a Prophet from the righteous.
verse.verse_113: We blessed him and Ishaq. And of their progeny are (some) that do right, and some that plainly wrong themselves.
verse.verse_114: And, indeed We gave Our grace to Musa and Harun.
verse.verse_115: And We saved them and their people from the great distress,
verse.verse_116: And helped them, so that they became the victors;
verse.verse_117: And We gave them the clear Scripture;
verse.verse_118: And guided them to the right path.
verse.verse_119: And We left for them among the later generations.
verse.verse_121: Verily, thus do We reward the doers of good.
verse.verse_122: Verily, they were two of Our believing servants.
verse.verse_123: And verily, Ilyas was one of the Messengers.
verse.verse_124: When he said to his people: "Will you not have Taqwa"
verse.verse_125: "Will you call upon `Ba`l and forsake the Best of creators,
verse.verse_126: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers"
verse.verse_127: But they denied him, so they will certainly be brought forth,
verse.verse_128: Save the chosen servants of Allah.
verse.verse_129: And We left for him among the later generations.
verse.verse_131: Verily, thus do We reward the doers of good.
verse.verse_132: Verily, he was one of Our believing servants.
verse.verse_133: And verily, Lut was one of the Messengers.
verse.verse_134: When We saved him and his family, all,
verse.verse_135: Except an old woman (his wife) who was among those who remained behind.
verse.verse_137: Verily, you pass by them in the morning.
verse.verse_138: And at night; will you not then reflect
verse.verse_139: And verily, Yunus was one of the Messengers.
verse.verse_140: When he ran to the laden ship:
verse.verse_141: Then he (agreed to) cast lots, and he was among the losers.
verse.verse_142: Then a (big) fish swallowed him as he had done an act worthy of blame.
verse.verse_143: Had he not been of them who glorify Allah,
verse.verse_144: He would have indeed remained inside its belly (the fish) till the Day of Resurrection.
verse.verse_145: But We cast him forth on the naked shore while he was sick,
verse.verse_146: And We caused a plant of gourd to grow over him.
verse.verse_147: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (people) or even more.
verse.verse_148: And they believed; so We gave them enjoyment for a while.
verse.verse_149: Now ask them: "Are there (only) daughters for your Lord and sons for them"
verse.verse_150: Or did We create the angels female while they were witnesses
verse.verse_151: Verily, it is of their falsehood that they say:
verse.verse_152: "Allah has begotten." And, verily, they are liars!
verse.verse_153: Has He (then) chosen daughters rather than sons
verse.verse_154: What is the matter with you How do you decide
verse.verse_156: Or is there for you a plain authority
verse.verse_157: Then bring your Book if you are truthful!
verse.verse_158: And they have invented a kinship between Him and the Jinn, but the Jinn know well that they have indeed to appear (before Him).
verse.verse_159: Glorified be Allah! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!
verse.verse_160: Except the servants of Allah, whom He chooses.
verse.verse_161: So, verily you and those whom you worship
verse.verse_163: Except those who are predestined to burn in Hell!
verse.verse_164: And there is not one of us (angels) but has his known place;
verse.verse_165: And verily, we (angels), we stand in rows;
verse.verse_166: And verily, we (angels) indeed are those who glorify.
verse.verse_167: And indeed they used to say:
verse.verse_168: "If we had a reminder as had the men of old,"
verse.verse_169: "We would have indeed been the chosen servants of Allah!"
verse.verse_170: But (now) they disbelieve therein, so they will come to know!
verse.verse_171: And, verily, Our Word has gone forth of old for Our servants, the Messengers,
verse.verse_172: That they verily would be made triumphant,
verse.verse_173: And that Our hosts! they verily would be the victors.
verse.verse_174: So, turn away from them for a while,
verse.verse_175: And watch them and they shall see!
verse.verse_176: Do they seek to hasten on Our torment
verse.verse_177: Then, when it descends in their courtyard, evil will be the morning for those who had warned!
verse.verse_178: So, turn away from them for a while,
verse.verse_179: And watch and they shall see!
verse.verse_180: Glorified be your Lord, the Lord of Al-`Izzah! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!
verse.verse_181: And Salam (peace!) be on the Messengers!
verse.verse_182: And all the praises and thanks be to Allah, Lord of all that exists.
